name: Dual Contouring with Adaptive Split Selection
definition: A mesh extraction method that converts voxel grid data into a triangle mesh by constructing quads from connected voxels and splitting them into triangles based on geometric alignment or weight products.
summary: Dual Contouring with Adaptive Split Selection is a mesh extraction method that dynamically selects quad triangulations to minimize surface distortion or respect weights, unlike its parent method which uses fixed diagonal splits.
